^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$.description:
It is possible to override any kind of address (EOA's, contracts and precompiles).
A client MUST reject a key that it does not support with error code -32602. A client MAY treat a key that differs from a key defined in this schema only in case as that defined key. It MUST then apply the key, and MUST reject two keys that differ only in case and name the same defined key with error code -32602. A client MAY support other keys that this schema does not define.

movePrecompileToAddress.description: Moves addresses precompile into the specified address. This move is done before the 'code' override is set. Can only move precompiles. The move does not change the EIP-2929 set of addresses that are warm at the start of each call. That set keeps the precompile addresses of the active fork, and the destination address is not warm because of the move.

traceTransfers.description:
Adds ETH transfers as ERC20 transfer events to the logs. These transfers have emitter contract parameter set as address(0xeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee).
In blocks where EIP-7708 is active, no synthetic transfer events are added. The protocol transfer logs emitted from address(0xfffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffe) cover the same transfers with the same topics and data, and the flag has no effect. The flag is deprecated for these blocks.
